ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われました。「そのとおりだ。アーモンドの木の名前は、『見張る』という言葉と似た音なのだ。わたしは、自分の言葉が必ず実現するように、それを見張っている。」

decisions.choice: watching: a play on the name of the almond tree in verse 11
alternatives: the almond as a sign that the word will come early or soon
decisions.reason: The almond tree is called *shaqed*, and "watching, keeping awake" is *shoqed*: the two words sound almost the same. The vision works through this sound. As the almond is the tree awake first, so the LORD is awake and watching over his word. The play on words cannot be kept in most translations; the sense is given and the link explained.

decisions.choice: you have done well to see: you have seen correctly
decisions.reason: The phrase approves Jeremiah's answer: he has named the thing rightly, and the name is the key to the message.

decisions.choice: watching over my word to do it: God himself makes his word come true
decisions.reason: What God says through the prophet does not fail (Isaiah 55:11). The same verb returns in 31:28: as God watched over Israel to uproot and tear down, so he will watch over them to build and to plant (compare verse 10).

decisions.choice: The name of the almond tree sounds like the word for 'watching.'
decisions.reason: Readable puts the explanation of the play on words into the text, since without it the reader cannot see why the almond tree matters (see m1).

decisions.choice: "el nombre del almendro suena como la palabra “vigilante”"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the explanation of the play on shaqed and shoqed goes into the text; Spanish "almendro" and "vigilante" do not sound alike, so Readable adds "en hebreo".

decisions.choice: ninakesha
decisions.reason: "Kukesha", to stay awake on watch, is the sense of shoqed, the word that sounds like the almond's name (meaning decision m1). Swahili cannot keep the sound-play, so Readable explains it and says it is in Hebrew ("Kwa Kiebrania"), which the English need not say.

decisions.choice: "Le nom de l’amandier ressemble au mot qui veut dire “veiller”"
decisions.reason: "Amandier" and "veiller" share no sound in French, so Readable explains the play on *shaqed* and *shoqed* (m1), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "tên cây hạnh nghe giống chữ 'canh thức'", with "Trong tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ" added
decisions.reason: The play on shaqed and shoqed cannot be heard in Vietnamese any more than in English, so Readable explains it in the text as the English Readable does, and says that the likeness of sound is in Hebrew.

decisions.choice: 지켜보다 (Literal, Balanced); the sound-play explained in the text (Readable)
decisions.reason: Korean cannot keep the play between *shaqed* (almond) and *shoqed* (watching). Literal and Balanced give the sense; Readable says in the text why the almond tree matters, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Em hebraico, o nome da amendoeira soa como a palavra 'vigiando'
alternatives: o nome da amendoeira soa como a palavra 'vigiando'
decisions.reason: Readable explains the play on words in the text, as the English Readable does (m1). Portuguese adds "Em hebraico", since "amendoeira" and "vigiando" sound nothing alike in Portuguese and the reader would otherwise look for the play in the Portuguese words.

decisions.choice: "በዕብራይስጥ የለውዝ ዛፍ ስም “መጠበቅ” ከሚለው ቃል ጋር ይመሳሰላል" (Readable)
alternatives: the English Readable wording without "in Hebrew"
decisions.reason: The play between the almond tree and "watching" works only in Hebrew; the Amharic names do not sound alike, so Readable says the likeness is in the Hebrew words.

decisions.choice: जागता (L); जागकर पहरा दे रहा (B); the play on words explained (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on shaqed (almond, the tree that wakes first) and shoqed (watching, being awake). Hindi बादाम cannot carry the sound, so Literal and Balanced keep the idea of waking (जागना), which links the tree that wakes first to God who stays awake over his word; Readable puts the explanation in the text, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: бодрствую (L, R); неусыпно слежу (B); the wordplay explained at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on shaqed, the almond ("the waking tree"), and shoqed, "watching". Russian миндаль has no such link, so Literal and Balanced keep the sense of watching without sleep, and Readable explains the sound, as the English Readable does, with "бодрствующий" so that the same verb follows.

decisions.choice: Readable explains the pun as the English Readable does, with the inner quotation in "『』".
decisions.reason: Japanese cannot reproduce shaqed / shoqed; the explanation stays a sentence inside God's words, as in the English.

am.B: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ወደ እኔ መጣ፦ «ምን ታያለህ?» እኔም እንዲህ አልኩ፦ «እሳቱ ተራግቦ የሚፈላ ድስት አያለሁ፤ አፉም ከሰሜን ወደ ደቡብ ያዘነበለ ነው።»

decisions.choice: blown upon: a pot over a fire fanned by blowing, so boiling hard
decisions.reason: The word means "blown on", of a fire made hotter by blowing (compare Job 41:12; Ezekiel 22:20-21). The pot is seething and about to boil over.

decisions.choice: its face from the face of the north: its mouth tilted away from the north, so that it pours out southward
alternatives: the pot is set facing away from the north
decisions.reason: The "face" of a pot is its front or mouth. The phrase most likely means that the pot stands in the north and is tipped to spill toward the south, onto Judah, as verse 14 explains. It could also mean simply that the pot faces from the north. The general sense, disaster coming from the north, is clear either way.

decisions.choice: toward the south (Balanced); about to spill toward the south (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say where a pot tilted away from the north will spill, following verse 14. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "hacia el sur" (B); "a punto de derramarse hacia el sur" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced and Readable, these levels say where a pot tilted away from the north will spill, following verse 14; Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: chungu
decisions.reason: The cooking pot of the vision is "chungu", the large pot set on a fire; "sufuria" is a metal pan.

decisions.reason: sir is a large cooking pot, हंडा; "blown upon" means the fire under it was fanned by blowing until it boiled hard (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Kutoka kaskazini mabaya yatafunguliwa juu ya wakaaji wote wa nchi.
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Kutoka kaskazini maafa yatafumuka juu ya kila mtu anayeishi katika nchi.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Taabu itatokea ghafla kutoka kaskazini. Itawaangukia wote wanaoishi katika nchi hii.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Từ phương bắc, tai họa sẽ bung ra trên tất cả dân cư của xứ.
vi.B: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Từ phương bắc, tai họa sẽ bùng ra trên mọi người sống trong xứ.
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Tai họa sẽ bùng ra từ phương bắc. Nó sẽ đổ xuống trên mọi người sống trong xứ này.

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "북쪽에서부터 재앙이 그 땅의 모든 주민에게 터져 나올 것이다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "북쪽에서 재앙이 터져 나와 이 땅에 사는 모든 사람을 덮칠 것이다.
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "북쪽에서 큰 어려움이 터져 나올 것이다. 그것이 이 땅에 사는 모든 사람에게 닥칠 것이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Do norte a desgraça será solta sobre todos os habitantes da terra.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Do norte a desgraça vai irromper sobre todos os que moram na terra.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Uma desgraça vai estourar lá do norte. Ela vai cair sobre todos os que moram nesta terra.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንዲህ አለኝ፦ «ከሰሜን መከራው በምድሪቱ ነዋሪዎች ሁሉ ላይ ይከፈታል።
am.B: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለኝ፦ «ከሰሜን በምድሪቱ በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ላይ ጥፋት ይፈነዳል።
am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለኝ፦ «መከራ ከሰሜን ይፈነዳል። በዚህች ምድር በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ላይ ይወርዳል።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, "उत्तर से देश के सब निवासियों पर विपत्ति खोल दी जाएगी।
hi.B: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, "उत्तर से देश में रहनेवाले हर एक पर विपत्ति टूट पड़ेगी।
hi.R: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, "उत्तर से संकट फूट पड़ेगा। वह इस देश में रहनेवाले हर व्यक्ति पर आ पड़ेगा।

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} мне: «С севера откроется бедствие на всех жителей земли.
ru.B: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал мне: «С севера вырвется бедствие на всех жителей страны.
ru.R: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал мне: «С севера вырвется беда. Она обрушится на всех, кто живёт в этой стране.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われた。「北から、その災いが、この地に住むすべての者の上に解き放たれる。
ja.B: すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われた。「北から、災いがこの地に住むすべての者の上に噴き出す。
ja.R: すると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われました。「北から災いが噴き出してくる。それは、この国に住むすべての人の上に降りかかる。

decisions.choice: from the north: the road by which invaders came into Judah
decisions.reason: The desert east of Judah blocked the direct way from Mesopotamia, so armies from Assyria and Babylon came down through Syria and entered the land from the north. The enemy is not named here; later the book names Babylon (20:4; 25:9).

decisions.choice: the disaster: calamity, harm
decisions.reason: The word can mean moral evil or harm that falls on people. Here it is the disaster of invasion. The same word names the people's "wickedness" in verse 16: their evil brings evil on them.

decisions.choice: will be let loose: will break open and pour out
decisions.reason: The verb is "be opened". The disaster bursts out like the contents of the tilted pot (verse 13), or like waters let loose.

decisions.choice: the land: the land of Judah
decisions.reason: The same word can mean the whole earth, but verse 15 shows that the land of Judah and its capital are meant.

decisions.choice: Trouble ... this land
decisions.reason: Readable uses a common word for the disaster and says "this land" to make clear it is Judah (see m4).

decisions.choice: mabaya (Literal); maafa (Balanced); taabu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word here is harm that falls on people, not wickedness (meaning decision m2), so no level uses "uovu".

decisions.choice: hara'ah "災い" (every level, through the book for the disaster from the north); yoshvei ha'arets "この地に住むすべての者" (L, B), "この国に住むすべての人" (R).
decisions.reason: One word for ra'ah as calamity; "悪" is kept for ra'ah as wickedness (1:16).

source.text: כִּ֣י׀הִנְנִ֣י קֹרֵ֗א לְכָֽל־מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת צָפ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וּבָ֡אוּ וְֽנָתְנוּ֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּסְא֜וֹ פֶּ֣תַח׀שַׁעֲרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְעַ֤ל כָּל־חוֹמֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְעַ֖ל כָּל־עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, I [am] calling to all [the] clans of [the] kingdoms of [the] north, declares Yahweh, and they will come and set each his throne [at the] entrance of [the] gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls around, and against all [the] cities of Judah.

en.L: For look, I [am] calling to all the clans of the kingdoms of the north, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q and they will come, and each will set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, \q and against all the cities of Judah.
en.B: For I am about to summon all the clans of the northern kingdoms, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They will come, and each of them will set up his throne at the entrance of Jerusalem's gates, against all its surrounding walls, \q and against all the towns of Judah.
en.R: I am about to call all the peoples of the kingdoms in the north, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Their kings will come and place their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem. \q They will attack all the walls around the city and all the towns of Judah.

es.L: Porque mira, yo llamo a todas las familias de los reinos del norte, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q y vendrán, y pondrá cada uno su trono a la entrada de las puertas de Jerusalén, y contra todos sus muros alrededor, \q y contra todas las ciudades de Judá.
es.B: Porque voy a convocar a todos los clanes de los reinos del norte, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Vendrán, y cada uno pondrá su trono a la entrada de las puertas de Jerusalén, contra todos los muros que la rodean, \q y contra todas las ciudades de Judá.
es.R: Voy a llamar a todos los pueblos de los reinos del norte, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Sus reyes vendrán y pondrán sus tronos a las puertas de Jerusalén. \q Atacarán todos los muros que rodean la ciudad y todas las ciudades de Judá.

fr.L: Car voici, j’appelle tous les clans des royaumes du nord, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q et ils viendront, et chacun placera son trône à l’entrée des portes de Jérusalem, et contre toutes ses murailles tout autour, \q et contre toutes les villes de Juda.
fr.B: Car je vais convoquer tous les clans des royaumes du nord, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Ils viendront, et chacun dressera son trône à l’entrée des portes de Jérusalem, contre toutes les murailles qui l’entourent \q et contre toutes les villes de Juda.
fr.R: Je vais appeler tous les peuples des royaumes du nord, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Leurs rois viendront installer leurs trônes aux portes de Jérusalem. \q Ils attaqueront toutes les murailles autour de la ville et toutes les villes de Juda.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, ninaziita koo zote za falme za kaskazini, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q nao watakuja, na kila mmoja ataweka kiti chake cha enzi penye maingilio ya malango ya Yerusalemu, na dhidi ya kuta zake zote pande zote, \q na dhidi ya miji yote ya Yuda.
sw.B: Kwa maana karibu nitaziita koo zote za falme za kaskazini, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Watakuja, na kila mmoja wao atasimika kiti chake cha enzi penye maingilio ya malango ya Yerusalemu, dhidi ya kuta zake zote zinazouzunguka, \q na dhidi ya miji yote ya Yuda.
sw.R: Ninakaribia kuyaita mataifa yote ya falme za kaskazini, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Wafalme wao watakuja na kuweka viti vyao vya enzi kwenye malango ya Yerusalemu. \q Watazishambulia kuta zote zinazouzunguka mji, na miji yote ya Yuda.

vi.L: Vì kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang gọi tất cả các gia tộc của các vương quốc phương bắc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; \q chúng sẽ đến, và mỗi kẻ sẽ đặt ngai mình nơi lối vào các cổng Giê-ru-sa-lem, nghịch cùng mọi tường thành chung quanh nó, \q và nghịch cùng mọi thành của Giu-đa.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp triệu tập tất cả các gia tộc của các vương quốc phương bắc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. \q Chúng sẽ đến, và mỗi kẻ sẽ lập ngai mình nơi lối vào các cổng Giê-ru-sa-lem, nghịch cùng mọi tường thành bao quanh nó, \q và nghịch cùng mọi thành của Giu-đa.
vi.R: Ta sắp gọi tất cả các dân tộc của những vương quốc phương bắc đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Vua của chúng sẽ đến và đặt ngai mình tại các cổng Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Chúng sẽ tấn công mọi tường thành quanh thành ấy và mọi thành của Giu-đa.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 북쪽 왕국들의 모든 족속을 부르고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 그들이 와서 각각 자기 보좌를 예루살렘 성문들 입구에 놓고, 그 둘레의 모든 성벽을 마주하고, \q 유다의 모든 성읍을 마주할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 이제 북쪽 왕국들의 모든 족속을 불러들이겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그들이 와서 저마다 예루살렘 성문 어귀에 자기 보좌를 차려 놓고, 둘레의 모든 성벽을 치며, \q 유다의 모든 성읍을 칠 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 이제 북쪽 나라들의 모든 민족을 부르겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그들의 왕들이 와서 예루살렘 성문 앞에 자기 보좌를 놓을 것이다. \q 그들은 도성을 둘러싼 모든 성벽과 유다의 모든 성읍을 공격할 것이다.

pt.L: Pois eis que eu [estou] chamando todos os clãs dos reinos do norte, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; \q e eles virão, e cada um porá o seu trono na entrada das portas de Jerusalém, e contra todos os seus muros ao redor, \q e contra todas as cidades de Judá.
pt.B: Pois estou para convocar todos os clãs dos reinos do norte, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Eles virão, e cada um deles vai armar o seu trono na entrada das portas de Jerusalém, contra todos os muros que a cercam \q e contra todas as cidades de Judá.
pt.R: Eu vou chamar todos os povos dos reinos do norte, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Os reis deles virão e porão os seus tronos junto às portas de Jerusalém. \q Eles vão atacar todos os muros em volta da cidade e todas as cidades de Judá.

am.L: እነሆ፣ የሰሜንን መንግሥታት ጎሳዎች ሁሉ እጠራለሁና፤ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ \q ይመጣሉም፤ እያንዳንዱም ዙፋኑን በኢየሩሳሌም በሮች መግቢያ ላይ፣ በዙሪያዋም ባሉ ቅጥሮቿ ሁሉ ላይ \q በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ያኖራል።
am.B: የሰሜንን መንግሥታት ጎሳዎች ሁሉ ልጠራ ነውና፤ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q እነርሱም ይመጣሉ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም ዙፋኑን በኢየሩሳሌም በሮች መግቢያ ላይ፣ በዙሪያዋ ባሉት ቅጥሮቿ ሁሉ ላይ፣ \q በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ያቆማል።
am.R: በሰሜን ያሉትን የመንግሥታት ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ልጠራ ነው፤ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q ነገሥታታቸው መጥተው ዙፋኖቻቸውን በኢየሩሳሌም በሮች ላይ ያስቀምጣሉ። \q በከተማዪቱ ዙሪያ ያሉትን ቅጥሮች ሁሉና የይሁዳን ከተሞች ሁሉ ይወጋሉ።

hi.L: क्योंकि देखो, मैं उत्तर के राज्यों के सब कुलों को बुला रहा [हूँ], {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है; \q और वे आएँगे, और हर एक यरूशलेम के फाटकों के प्रवेश पर अपना सिंहासन रखेगा, और उसके चारों ओर की सब शहरपनाहों के विरुद्ध, \q और यहूदा के सब नगरों के विरुद्ध।
hi.B: क्योंकि मैं उत्तरी राज्यों के सब कुलों को बुलाने पर हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। \q वे आएँगे, और उनमें से हर एक यरूशलेम के फाटकों के प्रवेश पर अपना सिंहासन रखेगा, उसकी चारों ओर की सब शहरपनाहों के सामने, \q और यहूदा के सब नगरों के सामने।
hi.R: मैं उत्तर के राज्यों के सब लोगों को बुलाने वाला हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q उनके राजा आकर यरूशलेम के फाटकों पर अपने सिंहासन रखेंगे। \q वे नगर के चारों ओर की सब शहरपनाहों पर और यहूदा के सब नगरों पर हमला करेंगे।

ru.L: Потому что вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} призываю все роды царств севера, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — \q и придут они, и поставят каждый свой престол у входа в ворота Иерусалима, и против всех его стен вокруг, \q и против всех городов Иуды.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вот-вот призову все роды северных царств, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Они придут, и каждый поставит свой престол у входа в ворота Иерусалима, против всех стен вокруг него \q и против всех городов Иуды.
ru.R: Я скоро призову все народы северных царств, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Их цари придут и поставят свои престолы у ворот Иерусалима. \q Они нападут на все стены вокруг города и на все города Иуды.

ja.L: まことに、見なさい、わたしは北の王国のすべての氏族を呼び寄せる。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉―― \q 彼らは来て、それぞれ自分の王座を、エルサレムの門の入り口に、その周りのすべての城壁に向かって据え、 \q ユダのすべての町々にも向かって[据える]。
ja.B: わたしは今、北の王国のすべての氏族を呼び寄せる、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q 彼らは来て、それぞれエルサレムの門の入り口に王座を設け、周りのすべての城壁に立ち向かい、 \q ユダのすべての町々に立ち向かう。
ja.R: わたしは、北にある王国のすべての民を呼び寄せる、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q その王たちがやって来て、エルサレムの門のところに自分の王座を置く。 \q 彼らは、町の周りのすべての城壁と、ユダのすべての町を攻める。

decisions.choice: the clans of the kingdoms of the north: the peoples that make up the northern powers
decisions.reason: "Clans" are the family groups that formed a people. The kingdoms are not named; Babylon and the peoples under its rule are later named as God's instrument (25:9).

decisions.choice: each will set his throne at the entrance of the gates: conquerors sitting as judges over the city
decisions.reason: The city gate was where judgment was given (Deuteronomy 21:19; Ruth 4:1-2). Enemy rulers setting their thrones there will sit in judgment over Jerusalem. It came true when the officers of the king of Babylon sat in the Middle Gate (39:3).

decisions.choice: against all its walls ... against all the cities of Judah: the invaders set against the city and the towns
decisions.reason: The preposition here means "against": the northern rulers come in hostility, besieging Jerusalem's walls and the towns of Judah.

decisions.choice: Their kings ... They will attack
decisions.reason: Readable says who sits on the thrones and what "against" the walls and towns means (see m3). It says "peoples" for "clans" because the clans here stand for whole nations.

decisions.choice: the verb रखेगा before the two "against" phrases
decisions.reason: Hindi puts the verb at the end of its clause, so the two phrases "against all its walls" and "against all the cities of Judah" follow the verb as additions, keeping the line break where the English has it.

decisions.choice: hineni + participle (God about to act) "見なさい、わたしは…" (L), "わたしは今…" (B), dropped (R) as the English.
decisions.reason: The prophetic convention for hinneh, with Balanced following the English "I am about to".

source.text: וְדִבַּרְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּטַי֙ אוֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל כָּל־רָעָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥י יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will speak my judgments [against] them for all their evil, who have forsaken me and made smoke to gods other and bowed down to [the] works of their hands.

en.L: And I will speak {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments against them for all their evil, \q who have forsaken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and made offerings smoke to other gods and bowed down to the works of their [own] hands.
en.B: I will pronounce {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sentence on them for all their wickedness, \q because they have abandoned {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, burned offerings to other gods, and bowed down to what their own hands have made.
en.R: I will announce {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgment on the people of Judah for all the evil they have done. \q They have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They have burned offerings to other gods and worshiped idols they made with their own hands.

es.L: Y pronunciaré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} juicios contra ellos por toda su maldad, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han abandonado y han quemado ofrendas a otros dioses y se han postrado ante las obras de sus [propias] manos.
es.B: Pronunciaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sentencia contra ellos por toda su maldad, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han abandonado, han quemado ofrendas a otros dioses y se han postrado ante lo que han hecho sus propias manos.
es.R: Anunciaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} juicio contra la gente de Judá por todo el mal que ha hecho. \q Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han dado la espalda. Han quemado ofrendas a otros dioses y adoran ídolos que ellos mismos han hecho con sus manos.

fr.L: Et je prononcerai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements contre eux pour toute leur méchanceté, \q eux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné, qui ont fait fumer [des offrandes] pour d’autres dieux et se sont prosternés devant les œuvres de leurs [propres] mains.
fr.B: Je prononcerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} sentence contre eux pour toute leur méchanceté, \q parce qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné, qu’ils ont brûlé des offrandes pour d’autres dieux et se sont prosternés devant ce que leurs mains ont fabriqué.
fr.R: J’annoncerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} jugement contre les habitants de Juda pour tout le mal qu’ils ont fait. \q Ils se sont détournés de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Ils ont brûlé des offrandes pour d’autres dieux et ils ont adoré des idoles qu’ils ont fabriquées de leurs propres mains.

sw.L: Nami nitatamka hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} juu yao kwa ajili ya uovu wao wote, \q ambao wameniacha, na kufukiza [sadaka] kwa miungu mingine, na kusujudia kazi za mikono yao [wenyewe].
sw.B: Nitatangaza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao kwa ajili ya uovu wao wote, \q kwa sababu wameniacha, wakafukiza sadaka kwa miungu mingine, na kuvisujudia vitu ambavyo mikono yao wenyewe imevitengeneza.
sw.R: Nitatangaza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu ya watu wa Yuda kwa ajili ya maovu yote waliyoyatenda. \q Wamegeuka na kuniacha. Wamefukiza sadaka kwa miungu mingine na kuabudu sanamu walizozitengeneza kwa mikono yao wenyewe.

vi.L: Ta sẽ phán những sự phán xét của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng chúng vì mọi điều ác của chúng, \q là những kẻ đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đã xông khói [tế lễ] cho các thần khác, và đã quỳ lạy công việc của tay [chính] chúng.
vi.B: Ta sẽ tuyên án chúng vì mọi điều gian ác của chúng, \q vì chúng đã chối bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đốt tế lễ cho các thần khác, và quỳ lạy những vật do chính tay chúng làm ra.
vi.R: Ta sẽ công bố án phạt của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên dân Giu-đa vì mọi điều ác chúng đã làm. \q Chúng đã quay lưng lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Chúng đã đốt tế lễ cho các thần khác và thờ lạy các thần tượng do chính tay chúng làm ra.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그들의 모든 악 때문에 그들에게 나의 심판들을 선고하겠다. \q 그들은 나를 버리고 다른 신들에게 [제물을] 태워 연기를 올렸으며 자기 손으로 만든 것들에게 절했다.
ko.B: 그들이 저지른 모든 악 때문에 내가 그들에게 판결을 내리겠다. \q 그들이 나를 버리고, 다른 신들에게 제물을 태워 바치고, 자기 손으로 만든 것에게 절했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 유다 백성이 저지른 모든 악 때문에 내가 그들에게 벌을 선고하겠다. \q 그들은 나를 떠났다. 그들은 다른 신들에게 제물을 태워 바쳤고, 자기 손으로 만든 우상들에게 절했다.

pt.L: E falarei os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} juízos contra eles por toda a maldade deles, \q que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaram e fizeram subir fumaça a outros deuses e se prostraram diante das obras das suas [próprias] mãos.
pt.B: Pronunciarei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} sentença contra eles por toda a sua maldade, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaram, queimaram ofertas a outros deuses e se prostraram diante do que as suas próprias mãos fizeram.
pt.R: Vou anunciar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} julgamento contra o povo de Judá por todo o mal que eles fizeram. \q Eles se afastaram de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Queimaram ofertas a outros deuses e adoraram ídolos que fizeram com as próprias mãos.

am.L: ስለ ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ፍርዶቼን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ፤ \q ትተውኛልና፤ ለሌሎችም አማልክት አጥነዋል፤ ለ[ገዛ] እጃቸውም ሥራ ሰግደዋል።
am.B: ስለ ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ፍርዴን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ፤ \q ትተውኛልና፤ ለሌሎች አማልክት መሥዋዕት አቃጥለዋል፤ የገዛ እጃቸው ለሠራውም ሰግደዋል።
am.R: የይሁዳ ሰዎች ስለ ሠሩት ክፋት ሁሉ ፍርዴን እናገርባቸዋለሁ። \q እነርሱ ከእኔ ርቀዋል። ለሌሎች አማልክት መሥዋዕት አቃጥለዋል፤ በገዛ እጃቸው ለሠሯቸው ጣዖታትም ሰግደዋል።

hi.L: और मैं उनकी सारी बुराई के कारण उन पर अपने न्याय के वचन कहूँगा, \q जिन्होंने मुझे त्याग दिया और दूसरे देवताओं के लिए [भेंटों का] धुआँ उठाया और अपने [ही] हाथों के कामों को दंडवत किया।
hi.B: मैं उनकी सारी दुष्टता के कारण उन पर अपना दंड सुनाऊँगा, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने मुझे त्याग दिया, दूसरे देवताओं के लिए भेंटें जलाईं, और अपने ही हाथों की बनाई चीज़ों को दंडवत किया।
hi.R: यहूदा के लोगों ने जो बुराई की है, उस सब के कारण मैं उन पर अपना न्याय सुनाऊँगा। \q उन्होंने मुझसे मुँह मोड़ लिया है। उन्होंने दूसरे देवताओं के लिए भेंटें जलाई हैं और अपने ही हाथों से बनाई मूर्तियों की पूजा की है।

ru.L: И произнесу {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} суды над ними за всё их зло, \q [они], которые оставили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, и воскуряли другим богам, и поклонялись делам своих рук.
ru.B: Я вынесу {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} приговор им за всё их нечестие, \q потому что они оставили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, сжигали жертвы другим богам и поклонялись тому, что сделали их собственные руки.
ru.R: Я объявлю {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} приговор народу Иуды за всё зло, которое они сделали. \q Они отвернулись от {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. Они сжигали жертвы другим богам и поклонялись идолам, которых сделали своими руками.

ja.L: そしてわたしは、彼らのすべての悪のゆえに、彼らに対してわたしの裁きを語る。 \q 彼らはわたしを捨て、ほかの神々に香をたき、自分の手で造ったものにひれ伏したのだ。
ja.B: わたしは、彼らのすべての悪のゆえに、彼らに判決を言い渡す。 \q 彼らがわたしを捨て、ほかの神々に香をたき、自分の手で造ったものを拝んだからだ。
ja.R: ユダの人々が行ったすべての悪のために、わたしは彼らに裁きを言い渡す。 \q 彼らはわたしに背を向けた。ほかの神々にささげ物を焼き、自分の手で造った偶像を拝んだのだ。

decisions.choice: speak my judgments against them: pass sentence on them as a judge
decisions.reason: The same expression is used when the king of Babylon passes sentence on Zedekiah (39:5; 52:9). God himself is the judge; the rulers of verse 15 carry out his sentence.

decisions.choice: them: the people of Judah and Jerusalem
decisions.reason: "Them" and "their evil" refer to the people of the land in verse 14 and the city and towns of verse 15, not to the invaders.

decisions.choice: made smoke: burned offerings or incense to other gods
decisions.reason: The verb means "to make smoke rise" and is used of burning sacrifices and incense. Jeremiah uses it often of offerings to other gods (7:9; 11:13; 44:17).

decisions.choice: the works of their hands: idols they had made themselves
decisions.reason: To bow down to what one's own hands have made is the folly the prophets mock (Isaiah 2:8; Psalm 115:4). Forsaking the LORD and worshiping idols is the root of all the evil the verse names.

decisions.choice: the people of Judah ... idols
decisions.reason: Readable names who "them" are (see m2) and what "the works of their hands" are (see m4).

decisions.choice: kufukiza [sadaka] (Literal); kufukiza sadaka (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Kufukiza" is to make smoke rise; with "sadaka" it covers both sacrifices and incense, as the Hebrew verb does (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: fizeram subir fumaça (L); queimaram ofertas (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "make smoke rise" (m3), of sacrifices and incense alike, so Literal keeps the picture and Balanced and Readable say "queimaram ofertas", which covers both; "incenso" alone would narrow it. Jeremiah uses the verb often (7:9; 11:13; 44:17), with the same words.

decisions.choice: "አጥነዋል" (Literal); "መሥዋዕት አቃጥለዋል" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "make smoke", of incense or offerings. Literal uses "አጠነ" (to burn incense, to make fragrant smoke); Balanced and Readable say "burned offerings", as the English levels do. Jeremiah uses the verb often for worship of other gods, and keeps this wording.

decisions.choice: [भेंटों का] धुआँ उठाया (L); भेंटें जलाईं (B, R)
decisions.reason: qitter means to make an offering go up in smoke, of incense or of a sacrifice (m3). धूप would narrow it to incense; Literal keeps the picture of smoke, Balanced and Readable say that offerings were burned. Book-wide choice for this verb in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: qitter "香をたく" (L, B), "ささげ物を焼く" (R, as the English R "burned offerings"), one form through Jeremiah (7:9, 11:12-17, 19:4, 44); hishtachavah "ひれ伏す" (L), "拝む" (B, R); 'azav "捨てる" (L, B), "背を向ける" (R).
alternatives: いけにえを焼いて煙にする (L)
decisions.reason: 2 Kings uses "香をたく" for qitter at the high places; m3 allows incense or offerings.

source.text: וְאַתָּה֙ תֶּאְזֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֔יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֙ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ אַל־תֵּחַת֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם פֶּֽן־אֲחִתְּךָ֖ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, you will gird up your loins and arise and speak to them all that I command you; do not be dismayed before them, lest I dismay you before them.

en.L: And you, you will gird up your loins and arise and speak to them all that I command you. \q Do not be dismayed before them, lest I dismay you before them.
en.B: As for you, tuck your robe into your belt, get up, and tell them everything I command you. \q Do not be shattered by them, or I will shatter you in front of them.
en.R: Now get ready for action! Stand up and tell them everything I command you. \q Do not let them fill you with terror, or I will fill you with terror in front of them.

es.L: Y tú, ceñirás tus lomos, y te levantarás y les dirás todo lo que yo te mande. \q No te aterres delante de ellos, no sea que yo te aterre delante de ellos.
es.B: Y tú, recógete la túnica en el cinturón, levántate y diles todo lo que yo te mande. \q No te dejes quebrantar por ellos, o yo te quebrantaré delante de ellos.
es.R: ¡Prepárate para actuar! Levántate y diles todo lo que yo te mande. \q No dejes que te llenen de terror, o yo te llenaré de terror delante de ellos.

fr.L: Et toi, tu ceindras tes reins, tu te lèveras et tu leur diras tout ce que je te commanderai. \q Ne sois pas effrayé devant eux, de peur que je ne t’effraie devant eux.
fr.B: Quant à toi, retrousse ton vêtement dans ta ceinture, lève-toi et dis-leur tout ce que je t’ordonnerai. \q Ne te laisse pas briser par eux, sinon je te briserai devant eux.
fr.R: Maintenant, prépare-toi à agir ! Lève-toi et dis-leur tout ce que je t’ordonnerai. \q Ne te laisse pas terroriser par eux, sinon je te remplirai de terreur devant eux.

sw.L: Nawe, utajifunga viuno vyako, na kuinuka, na kuwaambia yote nitakayokuamuru. \q Usivunjike mbele yao, nisije nikakuvunja mbele yao.
sw.B: Kwa upande wako, ikaze kanzu yako kiunoni, simama, uwaambie kila kitu ninachokuamuru. \q Usikubali hofu yao ikuvunje, la sivyo nitakuvunja mbele yao.
sw.R: Sasa jiandae kwa kazi! Simama uwaambie kila kitu ninachokuamuru. \q Usiwaache wakujaze hofu, la sivyo nitakujaza hofu mbele yao.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, ngươi hãy thắt lưng, đứng dậy, và nói với chúng mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho ngươi. \q Đừng kinh hãi trước mặt chúng, kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho ngươi kinh hãi trước mặt chúng.
vi.B: Còn con, hãy giắt áo vào thắt lưng, đứng dậy, và nói cho chúng mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho con. \q Đừng để chúng làm con khiếp đảm, kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm con khiếp đảm trước mặt chúng.
vi.R: Bây giờ con hãy sẵn sàng! Hãy đứng dậy và nói cho chúng mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho con. \q Đừng để chúng làm con sợ hãi, kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm con sợ hãi trước mặt chúng.

ko.L: 그러니 너는 네 허리를 동이고 일어나, 내가 너에게 명령하는 모든 것을 그들에게 말하여라. \q 그들 앞에서 무너지지 마라. 그렇지 않으면 내가 그들 앞에서 너를 무너지게 하겠다.
ko.B: 너는 옷자락을 허리띠에 걷어 매고 일어나, 내가 명령하는 것을 모두 그들에게 전하여라. \q 그들 때문에 겁에 질려 무너지지 마라. 그렇지 않으면 내가 그들 앞에서 너를 무너뜨리겠다.
ko.R: 이제 일할 채비를 하여라! 일어나서 내가 명령하는 것을 모두 그들에게 전하여라. \q 그들을 보고 두려워 떨지 마라. 그렇지 않으면 내가 그들 앞에서 너를 두려워 떨게 만들겠다.

pt.L: E tu, cingirás os teus lombos, e te levantarás, e lhes falarás tudo o que eu te ordenar. \q Não te apavores diante deles, para que eu não te apavore diante deles.
pt.B: Quanto a ti, prende a tua roupa no cinto, levanta-te e dize a eles tudo o que eu te ordenar. \q Não te deixes abater por eles, senão eu te abaterei diante deles.
pt.R: Agora, prepara-te para agir! Levanta-te e dize a eles tudo o que eu te mandar. \q Não deixes que eles te encham de pavor, senão eu vou te encher de pavor diante deles.

am.L: አንተም ወገብህን ትታጠቃለህ፤ ትነሣለህ፤ የማዝዝህንም ሁሉ ትነግራቸዋለህ። \q በፊታቸው አትደንግጥ፤ በፊታቸው እንዳላስደነግጥህ።
am.B: አንተ ግን ልብስህን በወገብህ ሸብ አድርገህ ተነሣ፤ የማዝዝህንም ሁሉ ንገራቸው። \q በእነርሱ ፊት አትሸበር፤ ያለዚያ እኔ በፊታቸው አሸብርሃለሁ።
am.R: አሁን ለሥራ ተዘጋጅ! ተነሣና የማዝዝህን ሁሉ ንገራቸው። \q እንዲያሸብሩህ አትፍቀድ፤ ያለዚያ እኔ በፊታቸው በፍርሃት እሞላሃለሁ።

hi.L: और तुम, तुम अपनी कमर कसो और उठो और जो कुछ मैं तुम्हें आज्ञा दूँ, वह सब उनसे कहो। \q उनके सामने न घबराओ, ऐसा न हो कि मैं तुम्हें उनके सामने घबरा दूँ।
hi.B: पर तुम अपना चोग़ा कमर में खोंस लो, उठो, और जो कुछ मैं तुम्हें आज्ञा दूँ, वह सब उनसे कहो। \q उनके कारण टूट मत जाना, नहीं तो मैं तुम्हें उनके सामने तोड़ दूँगा।
hi.R: अब काम के लिए तैयार हो जाओ! उठो और जो कुछ मैं तुम्हें आज्ञा दूँ, वह सब उन्हें बताओ। \q उनसे भयभीत मत होना, नहीं तो मैं तुम्हें उन्हीं के सामने भय से भर दूँगा।

ru.L: А ты — ты препояшешь свои чресла, и встанешь, и скажешь им всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелю тебе. \q Не ужасайся перед ними, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не поверг тебя в ужас перед ними.
ru.B: А ты подпояшь свою одежду, встань и скажи им всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелю тебе. \q Не трепещи перед ними, иначе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заставлю тебя трепетать перед ними.
ru.R: А теперь приготовься к делу! Встань и скажи им всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелю тебе. \q Не позволяй им наполнить тебя страхом, иначе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наполню тебя страхом перед ними.

ja.L: そしてあなたは、腰に帯を締め、立ち上がって、わたしがあなたに命じるすべてのことを彼らに語るのだ。 \q 彼らの前でおののくな。さもないと、わたしが彼らの前であなたをおののかせる。
ja.B: あなたは、衣のすそを帯にはさみ、立ち上がって、わたしが命じることをすべて彼らに告げなさい。 \q 彼らを前にしておじけづいてはならない。さもないと、わたしが彼らの前であなたをおじけづかせる。
ja.R: さあ、準備をしなさい！立ち上がって、わたしが命じることをすべて彼らに語りなさい。 \q 彼らを恐れて震え上がってはいけない。さもないと、わたしが彼らの前であなたを震え上がらせる。

decisions.choice: gird up your loins: tuck up your long robe into your belt, ready for action
decisions.reason: People wore long robes and tucked them into a belt to run, work or fight (1 Kings 18:46; 2 Kings 4:29; Job 38:3). God tells Jeremiah to get ready for the hard task ahead.

decisions.choice: be dismayed ... dismay you: be shattered with fear, and be shattered
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice: if Jeremiah gives way to fear of the people, God will let him be broken before them. The word means to be shattered, crushed with fear.

decisions.choice: you will gird up: a command
decisions.reason: The verbs are in a form that often gives instructions; here they tell Jeremiah what to do, in contrast with what God will do in verse 18.

decisions.choice: tuck your robe into your belt (Balanced); get ready for action (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture, worded as in 1 Kings 18:46; Readable gives its meaning.

decisions.choice: "ceñirás tus lomos" (L); "recógete la túnica en el cinturón" (B); "Prepárate para actuar" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced says what it meant, tucking a long robe into the belt; Readable gives the sense, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: utajifunga viuno vyako (Literal); ikaze kanzu yako kiunoni (Balanced); jiandae kwa kazi (Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as the published 1 Kings 18:46 at Literal and Balanced; Readable gives the meaning.

decisions.choice: usivunjike ... nisije nikakuvunja
decisions.reason: One verb, "-vunja" (break, shatter), is used twice as in the Hebrew, so the warning keeps its play: if Jeremiah breaks before them, God will break him (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "retrousse ton vêtement dans ta ceinture"
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture in the wording of 1 Kings 18:46; Literal keeps the old idiom "ceindre ses reins", Readable gives its meaning.

decisions.choice: "giắt áo vào thắt lưng" (Balanced); "hãy sẵn sàng" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "thắt lưng"; Balanced describes what the man does with his long robe, and Readable gives the sense, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: 무너지지 마라 ... 무너지게 하겠다
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb twice, "be shattered" and "shatter"; Korean keeps the repetition with 무너지다 / 무너뜨리다, which carries the sense of being broken by fear.

decisions.choice: apavorar (L); abater (B); encher de pavor (R)
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice (m2), and each level repeats one Portuguese verb so the warning turns back on Jeremiah as in the Hebrew: "apavorar" at Literal, "abater", which says both crushed and disheartened, at Balanced, "encher de pavor" at Readable.

decisions.choice: अपनी कमर कसो (L); अपना चोग़ा कमर में खोंस लो (B); काम के लिए तैयार हो जाओ (R)
decisions.reason: The same picture as 1 Kings 18:46, worded at Literal and Balanced as it is there; Readable gives its meaning.

decisions.choice: подпояшь свою одежду
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of tucking up the long robe, worded as 1 Kings 18:46 in this translation; Literal keeps "препояшешь свои чресла".

decisions.choice: The pair tachat / 'achittekha with one verb at each level: "おののく / おののかせる" (L), "おじけづく / おじけづかせる" (B), "震え上がる / 震え上がらせる" (R); the verse forms of command: "〜のだ" for the Hebrew future, "〜するな" (L), "〜してはならない" (B), "〜してはいけない" (R).
decisions.reason: The repetition is the point of the warning (m2), so the same verb is kept on both sides.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נְתַתִּ֣יךָ הַיּ֗וֹם לְעִ֨יר מִבְצָ֜ר וּלְעַמּ֥וּד בַּרְזֶ֛ל וּלְחֹמ֥וֹת נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ לְמַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ לְשָׂרֶ֔יהָ לְכֹהֲנֶ֖יהָ וּלְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, look, I have made you the day [this] into a city of fortification and into a pillar of iron and into walls of bronze against all the land, to [the] kings of Judah, to its princes, to its priests and to [the] people of the land.

en.L: And I, look, I have made you this day into a fortified city and into a pillar of iron and into walls of bronze against all the land, \q against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
en.B: And I, for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} part, have made you today a walled city, a pillar of iron, and walls of bronze, set against the whole land: \q against Judah's kings and officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
en.R: Today I am making you as hard to defeat as a city with strong walls, an iron pillar or walls of bronze. \q You will stand against everyone in the land: the kings of Judah, its leaders, its priests and all its people.

es.L: Y yo, mira, te he puesto hoy como ciudad fortificada, y como columna de hierro, y como muros de bronce contra toda la tierra, \q contra los reyes de Judá, contra sus príncipes, contra sus sacerdotes y contra el pueblo de la tierra.
es.B: Y yo, por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} parte, te he puesto hoy como ciudad amurallada, columna de hierro y muros de bronce frente a toda la tierra: \q frente a los reyes y los jefes de Judá, sus sacerdotes y el pueblo de la tierra.
es.R: Hoy te hago tan difícil de vencer como una ciudad con murallas fuertes, una columna de hierro o unos muros de bronce. \q Te enfrentarás a todos los que viven en el país: los reyes de Judá, sus dirigentes, sus sacerdotes y toda su gente.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, voici, j’ai fait de toi en ce jour une ville fortifiée, une colonne de fer et des murailles de bronze contre tout le pays, \q contre les rois de Juda, contre ses princes, contre ses prêtres et contre le peuple du pays.
fr.B: Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} côté, j’ai fait de toi aujourd’hui une ville fortifiée, une colonne de fer, des murailles de bronze, dressées contre tout le pays : \q contre les rois de Juda et ses chefs, contre ses prêtres et contre le peuple du pays.
fr.R: Aujourd’hui, je te rends aussi difficile à vaincre qu’une ville aux murailles solides, une colonne de fer ou des murailles de bronze. \q Tu tiendras bon face à tout le pays : les rois de Juda, ses chefs, ses prêtres et tout son peuple.

sw.L: Nami, tazama, nimekufanya leo hii kuwa mji wenye ngome, na nguzo ya chuma, na kuta za shaba, dhidi ya nchi yote, \q dhidi ya wafalme wa Yuda, dhidi ya wakuu wake, dhidi ya makuhani wake, na dhidi ya watu wa nchi.
sw.B: Nami kwa upande {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, leo nimekufanya mji wenye kuta, nguzo ya chuma na kuta za shaba, ukisimama dhidi ya nchi yote: \q dhidi ya wafalme wa Yuda na maafisa wake, makuhani wake, na watu wa nchi.
sw.R: Leo ninakufanya kuwa mgumu kushindwa kama mji wenye kuta imara, nguzo ya chuma au kuta za shaba. \q Utasimama dhidi ya kila mtu katika nchi: wafalme wa Yuda, viongozi wake, makuhani wake na watu wake wote.

vi.L: Còn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, kìa, ngày nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho ngươi thành một thành kiên cố, một cột sắt, và những tường đồng nghịch cùng cả xứ, \q nghịch cùng các vua Giu-đa, các quan trưởng nó, các thầy tế lễ nó, và dân của xứ.
vi.B: Về phần {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hôm nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho con thành một thành có tường vững chắc, một cột sắt, những bức tường đồng, đứng nghịch cùng cả xứ: \q nghịch cùng các vua và các quan chức Giu-đa, các thầy tế lễ và dân trong xứ.
vi.R: Hôm nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho con vững chắc như một thành có tường kiên cố, như một cột sắt hay những bức tường đồng, không ai đánh đổ được. \q Con sẽ đứng vững trước mọi người trong xứ: các vua Giu-đa, các nhà lãnh đạo, các thầy tế lễ và toàn dân.

ko.L: 나는, 보아라, 내가 이날 너를 견고한 성읍과 쇠기둥과 놋 성벽으로 만들어 온 땅에 맞서게 했다. \q 유다의 왕들과 그 고관들과 그 제사장들과 그 땅의 백성에게 맞서게 했다.
ko.B: 나로서는 오늘 너를 성벽을 두른 성읍과 쇠기둥과 놋 성벽으로 만들어 온 땅에 맞서게 했다. \q 유다의 왕들과 관리들과 제사장들과 그 땅의 백성에게 맞서게 했다.
ko.R: 오늘 내가 너를 튼튼한 성벽을 두른 성읍처럼, 쇠기둥이나 놋 성벽처럼 아무도 무너뜨릴 수 없게 만든다. \q 너는 이 땅의 모든 사람, 곧 유다의 왕들과 지도자들과 제사장들과 모든 백성에게 맞설 것이다.

pt.L: E eu, eis que te fiz neste dia uma cidade fortificada, e uma coluna de ferro, e muros de bronze contra toda a terra, \q contra os reis de Judá, contra os seus príncipes, contra os seus sacerdotes e contra o povo da terra.
pt.B: E eu, da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} parte, fiz de ti hoje uma cidade cercada de muros, uma coluna de ferro e muralhas de bronze, contra a terra inteira: \q contra os reis e os oficiais de Judá, contra os seus sacerdotes e contra o povo da terra.
pt.R: Hoje eu faço de ti alguém tão difícil de vencer como uma cidade de muros fortes, uma coluna de ferro ou muralhas de bronze. \q Tu vais enfrentar todos nesta terra: os reis de Judá, os seus líderes, os seus sacerdotes e todo o seu povo.

am.L: እኔም እነሆ፣ በዚህ ቀን በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ላይ የተመሸገች ከተማ፣ የብረትም ምሰሶ፣ የነሐስም ቅጥሮች አደረግኩህ፤ \q በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ላይ፣ በመኳንንቷ ላይ፣ በካህናቷ ላይ፣ በምድሪቱም ሕዝብ ላይ።
am.B: እኔም በበኩሌ ዛሬ የተመሸገች ከተማ፣ የብረት ምሰሶና የነሐስ ቅጥሮች አድርጌሃለሁ፤ በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ላይ ትቆማለህ፤ \q በይሁዳ ነገሥታትና ሹማምንት ላይ፣ በካህናቷና በምድሪቱ ሕዝብ ላይ።
am.R: ዛሬ ጠንካራ ቅጥር እንዳላት ከተማ፣ እንደ ብረት ምሰሶ ወይም እንደ ነሐስ ቅጥሮች ለማሸነፍ አስቸጋሪ አደርግሃለሁ። \q በምድሪቱ ባሉት ሁሉ ላይ ትቆማለህ፤ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት፣ በመሪዎቿ፣ በካህናቷና በሕዝቧ ሁሉ ላይ።

hi.L: और मैं, देखो, मैंने आज के दिन तुम्हें सारे देश के विरुद्ध एक गढ़वाला नगर और लोहे का खंभा और पीतल की शहरपनाह बनाया है, \q यहूदा के राजाओं के विरुद्ध, उसके हाकिमों के विरुद्ध, उसके याजकों के विरुद्ध, और देश के लोगों के विरुद्ध।
hi.B: और मैंने भी आज तुम्हें एक गढ़वाला नगर, लोहे का खंभा और पीतल की दीवारें बना दिया है, सारे देश के सामने: \q यहूदा के राजाओं और अधिकारियों के, उसके याजकों के और देश के लोगों के सामने।
hi.R: आज मैं तुम्हें ऐसा बना रहा हूँ कि तुम्हें कोई हरा न सके, जैसे मज़बूत शहरपनाहवाला नगर, लोहे का खंभा या पीतल की दीवारें। \q तुम देश के हर व्यक्ति के सामने डटे रहोगे: यहूदा के राजाओं, उसके अगुवों, उसके याजकों और उसके सब लोगों के सामने।

ru.L: А {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал тебя в этот день городом укреплённым, и столбом железным, и стенами медными против всей земли, \q против царей Иуды, против его князей, против его священников и против народа земли.
ru.B: Я же сегодня сделал тебя укреплённым городом, железным столбом и медными стенами против всей страны: \q против царей Иуды и его вельмож, его священников и народа страны.
ru.R: Сегодня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} делаю тебя таким же несокрушимым, как город с крепкими стенами, как железный столб или медные стены. \q Ты будешь стоять против всех в этой стране: против царей Иуды, его начальников, его священников и всего его народа.

ja.L: そしてわたしは、見なさい、今日あなたを、全地に対して、要塞の町、鉄の柱、青銅の城壁とした。 \q ユダの王たち、その長たち、その祭司たち、そして国の民に対して[そうした]。
ja.B: わたしのほうでは、今日あなたを、堅固な町、鉄の柱、青銅の城壁とし、全地に立ち向かわせる。 \q ユダの王たちと高官たち、その祭司たち、そして国の民に立ち向かわせるのだ。
ja.R: 今日、わたしはあなたを、強い城壁のある町や、鉄の柱や、青銅の城壁のように、だれにも打ち負かされない者にする。 \q あなたは、この国のすべての人、つまり、ユダの王たち、その指導者たち、祭司たち、そして国中の人々に立ち向かう。

decisions.choice: a fortified city, a pillar of iron, walls of bronze: strength that cannot be broken
decisions.reason: The pictures do not promise that Jeremiah will not be attacked, but that he will stand firm when he is (verse 19). God repeats the promise of bronze walls when Jeremiah is near despair (15:20).

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the citizens of Judah
decisions.reason: The phrase names the landholding people of Judah, who had a voice in public affairs and even made kings (2 Kings 21:24; 23:30). Here they stand beside the kings, officials and priests: the whole nation.

decisions.choice: I have made you: already decided and done
decisions.reason: As in verse 10 ("I have appointed"), God speaks of his decision as already done, though Jeremiah will live it out over many years.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word means the royal officials and leading men of Judah; each level uses the wording it has elsewhere.

decisions.choice: as hard to defeat as
decisions.reason: Readable turns the pictures into a comparison so the reader sees what they mean (see m1).

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L); "jefes" (B); "dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: Judah's sarim are its ruling officials: Literal keeps the traditional "príncipes", Balanced and Readable say what they were, as the English levels do. The same three words hold for sarim through Jeremiah, as published 2 Chronicles.

decisions.choice: wakuu (Literal); maafisa (Balanced); viongozi (Readable)
decisions.reason: The royal officials of Judah, worded at each level as in 2 Kings 24:12.

decisions.choice: "princes" (L); "chefs" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The royal officials of Judah (*sarim*) take the wording of 2 Kings 24:12-14 at each level; "hauts fonctionnaires" stays for *sarisim*.

decisions.choice: "moi" under the deity_pronoun setting on God's emphatic "Et moi"
decisions.reason: The English has no pronoun span here because English "I" takes none; French needs the free pronoun "moi", which takes the setting like God's other free pronouns.

decisions.choice: "các quan trưởng" (Literal); "các quan chức" (Balanced); "các nhà lãnh đạo" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The officials (sarim) of the court, as Kings renders them; "hoàng tử" would wrongly make them the king's sons.

decisions.choice: 고관들 (Literal); 관리들 (Balanced); 지도자들 (Readable)
decisions.reason: The *sarim* are the king's officials. 방백 is the older church word; Literal uses 고관, Balanced 관리 and Readable 지도자, through the book.

decisions.choice: príncipes (L); oficiais (B); líderes (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the English (r-en-1): the sarim, the royal officials and leading men of Judah, are "príncipes" at Literal, "oficiais" at Balanced and "líderes" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "መኳንንት" (Literal); "ሹማምንት" (Balanced); "መሪዎች" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The princes of Judah (sarim) are the king's officials; the three words follow the English levels and are kept through Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: हाकिम (L); अधिकारी (B); अगुवे (R)
decisions.reason: The sarim of Judah are the royal officials, worded as Ezra and Nehemiah word the king's sarim in this translation. Book-wide choice for Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: князья (L); вельможи (B); начальники (R)
decisions.reason: The royal officials (sarim), in the words Ezra and Nehemiah use for the king's officials at each level.

decisions.choice: sarim "長たち" (L), "高官たち" (B), "指導者たち" (R), as Isaiah; 'am ha'arets "国の民" (L, B), "国中の人々" (R), as 2 Kings 21:24.
decisions.reason: The forms of the prophetic conventions and of Kings.

source.text: וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹא־י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֖ה לְהַצִּילֶֽךָ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they will fight against you, but not they will prevail against you, for with you I [am], declares Yahweh, to deliver you.

en.L: And they will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you, \q for with you I [am], declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to deliver you."
en.B: They will make war on you, but they will not overcome you, \q for I am with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to rescue you."
en.R: They will fight against you, but they will not defeat you. \q I am with you, and I will keep you safe, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Y pelearán contra ti, pero no prevalecerán contra ti, \q porque contigo [estoy] yo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, para librarte».
es.B: Te harán la guerra, pero no te vencerán, \q porque yo estoy contigo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, para rescatarte».
es.R: Pelearán contra ti, pero no te derrotarán. \q Yo estoy contigo y te protegeré, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et ils combattront contre toi, mais ils ne l’emporteront pas sur toi, \q car avec toi je [suis], déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour te délivrer. »
fr.B: Ils te feront la guerre, mais ils ne te vaincront pas, \q car je suis avec toi, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour te délivrer. »
fr.R: Ils te combattront, mais ils ne te vaincront pas. \q Je suis avec toi et je te protégerai, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Nao watapigana nawe, lakini hawatakushinda, \q kwa maana pamoja nawe mimi [niko], asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kukuokoa."
sw.B: Watapigana nawe, lakini hawatakushinda, \q kwa maana niko pamoja nawe, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili nikuokoe."
sw.R: Watapigana nawe, lakini hawatakushinda. \q Niko pamoja nawe, nami nitakulinda salama, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Chúng sẽ đánh nghịch ngươi, nhưng sẽ không thắng được ngươi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, để giải cứu ngươi."
vi.B: Chúng sẽ giao chiến với con, nhưng không thắng nổi con, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với con, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, để cứu con."
vi.R: Chúng sẽ đánh con, nhưng không đánh bại được con. \q Ta ở với con, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giữ con được an toàn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán."

ko.L: 그들이 너와 싸우겠지만 너를 이기지 못할 것이다. \q 내가 너와 함께 있어 너를 건져 낼 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다."
ko.B: 그들이 너에게 맞서 싸우겠지만 너를 이기지 못할 것이다. \q 내가 너와 함께 있으면서 너를 구해 낼 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."
ko.R: 그들이 너와 싸우겠지만 너를 이기지 못할 것이다. \q 내가 너와 함께 있으면서 너를 지켜 주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."

pt.L: E eles lutarão contra ti, mas não prevalecerão contra ti, \q pois contigo eu [estou], declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, para te livrar."
pt.B: Eles vão guerrear contra ti, mas não vão te vencer, \q pois eu estou contigo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, para te resgatar."
pt.R: Eles vão lutar contra ti, mas não vão te derrotar. \q Eu estou contigo e vou te proteger, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."

am.L: ይዋጉሃል፤ ነገር ግን አያሸንፉህም፤ \q ላድንህ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና፤ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።»
am.B: ይዋጉሃል፤ ነገር ግን አያሸንፉህም፤ \q ልታደግህ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና፤ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።»
am.R: ይዋጉሃል፤ ነገር ግን አያሸንፉህም። \q እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፤ ከክፉም እጠብቅሃለሁ፤ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።»

hi.L: और वे तुमसे लड़ेंगे, पर तुम पर प्रबल न होंगे, \q क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारे साथ [हूँ], {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, कि तुम्हें छुड़ाऊँ।"
hi.B: वे तुमसे युद्ध करेंगे, पर तुम पर जय न पाएँगे, \q क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, कि तुम्हें छुड़ाऊँ।"
hi.R: वे तुमसे लड़ेंगे, पर तुम्हें हरा नहीं पाएँगे। \q मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ, और मैं तुम्हें सुरक्षित रखूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।"

ru.L: И будут воевать против тебя, но не одолеют тебя, \q потому что с тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — чтобы избавлять тебя.»
ru.B: Они будут воевать с тобой, но не одолеют тебя, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с тобой, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — чтобы избавить тебя.»
ru.R: Они будут воевать с тобой, но не победят тебя. \q Я с тобой, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сохраню тебя, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»

ja.L: 彼らはあなたと戦うが、あなたに勝つことはできない。 \q わたしがあなたと共にいて――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――、あなたを救い出すからだ。」
ja.B: 彼らはあなたに戦いを挑むが、あなたを打ち負かすことはできない。 \q わたしがあなたと共にいて、あなたを助け出すからだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。」
ja.R: 彼らはあなたと戦う。しかし、あなたを打ち負かすことはできない。 \q わたしがあなたと一緒にいて、あなたを守るからだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。」

decisions.choice: for with you I am ... to deliver you: the promise of verse 8 repeated
decisions.reason: The call ends with the same promise with which it began (verse 8), and 15:20 repeats this verse almost word for word when Jeremiah complains to God.

decisions.choice: prevail against you: overpower you
decisions.reason: The verb means to be able, to have the power; with "against" it means to win the struggle (Genesis 32:26; Psalm 129:2).

decisions.choice: to rescue you (Balanced); I will keep you safe (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 8, so the two promises read alike.
